title: Unify credential interfaces and add typed streaming helpers (batteries-included)
author: Elena Park
description: Motivation: multiple SDKs had subtly divergent credential shapes and streaming helper ergonomics that made cross-language parity and platform tooling flaky. This PR unifies the credential interface surface across Python/TypeScript/Go, introduces typed streaming helper libraries (pull/push adapters and 'resume' primitives) in each SDK, harmonizes retry presets for auth failures, and bumps SDK package versions. Scope summary: - Stabilize credential provider contract (CredentialProvider interface) so the control plane can rely on a single exchange format. - Add typed stream helpers that encapsulate reconnect/reauth/resume logic and expose a small ergonomic API in each SDK. - Normalize default retry/backoff presets for 401/429/5xx and add a clear opt-out knob. - Minimal server-side compatibility shims in the redwood API client used by the SDKs to avoid a large rollout risk. - Docs and cross-SDK examples updated plus new conformance tests. Checklist: [x] Design doc attached in Linear (ENG-9742) [x] Unit+integration tests for Python/TS/Go [x] Backwards-compatibility audit done (no req'd client migrations) [x] Release notes drafted [x] Version bumps: python->2.4.0, typescript->1.27.0, go->1.8.0 Backwards-compat notes: The credential provider surface is widened (adds Inspect/Lease metadata methods) but default credential implementations remain unchanged. Consumers implementing custom providers will need a thin shim (commented migration snippet included). Rollout plan: merge to main, publish patch SDKs as pre-release, monitor canary product (dedicated customers) for 72h, then promote. Contact: @elenapark for questions.
